policy.compatibility: Every breaking change requires observed evidence, a replacement, an automated or documented migration, and consumer validation.
policy.nativeGraduation: Every public package and native adapter graduates together only after the readiness ledger is complete.
policy.nonGoal: Do not manufacture web breakage to justify the coordinated major release.

changes.currentContract: UIPrimitives is exported from the Astro root barrel, so an otherwise static root import can pull the progressive-enhancement runtime into the emitted module graph.
changes.replacement: Import UIPrimitives as the default export from @santi020k/lumen-astro/runtime; keep static components as named root imports or direct component imports.
changes.migration: The Lumen v2 migrator splits UIPrimitives from mixed Astro imports and rewrites it to the runtime subpath. The transform must be idempotent and support dry-run output.

changes.currentContract: Astro and Elements still accept size=sm|default|lg as a pre-1.0 visual alias on Input and NativeSelect, colliding with the native numeric size attribute.
changes.replacement: Use visualSize in Astro and visual-size in Elements for visual sizing; reserve size for the native numeric attribute.
changes.migration: The Lumen v2 migrator rewrites only literal sm, default, and lg values on Lumen Input and NativeSelect usage. Dynamic values require a diagnostic and manual review.

changes.currentContract: Sonner remains a public component name and adapter export even though Toast is the intentional documented notification entry point and Sonner has no public component guide.
changes.replacement: Use Toast and the framework-specific toast controller or provider. Keep the notification viewport as an implementation detail of the Toast contract.
changes.migration: The Lumen v2 migrator replaces direct Sonner imports and markup only when it can preserve placement and maximum-count configuration; custom child content requires manual review.

investigations.decisionGate: Measure React Server Component and bundle behavior, add a compatible server-safe entrypoint in 1.x, and validate both production-shaped Next.js consumers before deciding whether the v2 root changes.
Add granular registration compatibly, measure output, and gather a real Elements consumer before deprecating full-catalog registration.
Create the web API baseline and complete a consumer import audit before removing umbrella reexports in favor of explicit core subpaths.
